title: Towards Scientific Intelligence: A Survey of LLM-based Scientific Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of mitigation strategies, specifically surveying the use of counterfactual retrieval prompts that intentionally seek contradictory findings to reduce confirmation bias in scientific retrieval pipelines.

Literature review of approaches to audit and mitigate biases in scientific inferences, including surveying the use of diverse data, fairness-aware algorithms, systematic bias audits, and transparent data provenance.
